condition.description: action='create'. Semantic condition checked on each memory_recall; needed without triggerAt.

content.description: action='create'. Text shown when it fires.

idempotencyKey.description: Retry key: a resend returns the first result.

targetWorkspaceId.description: Write to this workspace UUID instead (needs write/admin; IDs: memory_context). action='create' only.

triggerAt.description: action='create'. ISO 8601 earliest fire time (checked every 30s); needed without condition. With both, a later memory_recall must match condition.
